name: Shinsen
tagline: Shibuya in 2 minutes and Shinjuku in 12 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥150,000 to ¥160,000.
summary: The station is in Shibuya City, served by Keio Inokashira Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 26 minutes to Otemachi, 12 minutes to Shinjuku, 2 minutes to Shibuya and 28 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥150,000 to ¥160,000. The station stands 26.9 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 7.8 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 26.9 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 26.9 m to 34.7 m, a difference of 7.8 m. These figures were read from the elevation API of the Geospatial Information Authority of Japan at nine points: the station itself and eight compass directions 400 m out.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 1 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is less than 0.5 m. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.

groceries.name: ファミリーショップ もりおかや

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 9 clinics and 17 pharmacies. Facilities recorded as hospitals lie at 明生会セントラル病院分院, about 265 m away and 明生会セントラル病院, about 402 m away. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Keio Inokashira Line. Only one line runs here, so when it stops you will be walking to a station on another line. Scored out of 100 from the number of lines and the spread of operators, transfer convenience here comes to 32.

rentRange.note: One room ¥150,000 to ¥160,000, 1K ¥140,000 to ¥150,000, 1LDK ¥240,000 to ¥250,000 and 2LDK ¥370,000 to ¥380,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

neighbours.lead: Shibuya is ahead on the number of lines and how close the centre is, but Shinsen is ahead on quiet.
neighbours.note: 741 m away in a straight line. It reaches Otemachi 7 minutes sooner than Shinsen.

neighbours.lead: rents are lower at Komaba-Todaimae, but Shinsen is ahead on the number of medical facilities and how easy the shopping is.
neighbours.note: 852 m away in a straight line. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Shinsen. One-room rents run about ¥34,000 lower.

noiseSources: The 首都高速3号渋谷線 viaduct runs 219 m away. It is an expressway, so traffic is audible day and night
The nearest big road is 旧山手通り, 201 m away, so little traffic noise reaches the station area

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 13 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 1 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Among the 23 wards' stations, very few of the points around this one fall inside the projected inundation area for the largest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: 2 lines serve the station. The choice of connections is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the high side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the high side for the 23 wards.
leads.noiseSources: 首都高速3号渋谷線 runs 219 m away, so whether a flat faces it changes what you hear indoors.
